subject.title: fix(feishu): replace longer mention keys first

question: Should this maintainer-owned Feishu mention-normalization fix land now based on source/test proof, or wait for live Feishu round-trip proof?
rationale: The patch is a focused Feishu channel bug fix with no blocking findings, but the protected maintainer label and lack of live tenant proof make final landing a human maintainer choice.

options.title: Land after maintainer review

options.title: Request live Feishu proof
options.body: Ask for a live group-message round trip before merge if maintainers want channel-level evidence beyond the pure normalizer.

options.title: Pause or close
options.body: Do not land the change if maintainers decide the Feishu channel behavior should remain unchanged or needs a different owner-level approach.
